tagline: Let's make sure AI development happens safely
note: The example group whose materials fill the commons. Values follow the group's own design guide: Hanken Grotesk is the main font, Vollkorn the secondary serif, violet-blue and dark purple are accents.
Colours and fonts as the browser shows them on the group's site: the light theme's blue and paper, the dark theme's light blue and background. Logo: the boat mark and wordmark as published.

tagline: Students from Saarland University working to make AI go well.
note: Colours and font as the browser shows them on the group's site (leaf green, the lighter green of its buttons, the near-black green background, the pale green behind its logo). Logo: the published outline-of-Saarland logo; the wide version is set like the page header.

tagline: We are a student group working to reduce the risks from artificial intelligence
note: Colours and body font as the browser shows them on the group's site (indigo, the lavender of its header, black, white). Headings there use Futura PT, which is not on Google Fonts; Jost is the closest match. Logo: the published mark in blue and in white; the wide version adds the group's name.

tagline: Durham students and academics for reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI
note: Colours and fonts as the browser shows them on the group's site (Durham purple, bright purple, navy background, its off-white). Logo: the published DAISI logo; the wide version is set like the page header.

tagline: Ensuring a beneficial future amidst advanced intelligence.
note: Colours and heading font as the browser shows them on the group's site (the red of its logo, slate, navy background, its off-white). Body text there uses the device's own sans-serif; Inter stands in for it. Logo: the red tile with the shield from the page header, set with the name as in that header.

tagline: La primera iniciativa estudiantil de Seguridad de la Inteligencia Artificial en Chile.
note: Colours and font as the browser shows them on the group's site (blue, indigo, navy background, its off-white). Logo: the published shield; the site only has it in white, so the version for light backgrounds is the same drawing in the site's navy.

tagline: Students at Tufts University committed to understanding and reducing the risks of advanced AI systems.
note: Colours and font as the browser shows them on the group's site (the blue of its panels and buttons, the brighter blue of its mark, near-black text, pale grey). Logo: the published TASSA banner; the square is the mark cut out of it, and the version for dark backgrounds has the black letters in white.
